text:
maria.g: Quick follow-up from the postmortem earlier — need owners for the streaming/chat reliability action items (timeouts, partial responses, reconnect logic). Can people ack and give rough ETA? Pattern: 3 incidents in last 30d with partial responses on long streams.

alex.k: I can own reconnect logic + client backoff. Plan: implement layered reconnect + server heartbeat. ETA: PR by Tue (3 days). Will include unit tests.

lee: I'll take timeouts/partial-response mitigation. I'll add stricter streaming timeouts, enforce keepalive, and change default client retry to jittered exponential. ETA: end of week.

sam: I'll handle monitoring, metrics, and runbook updates. Will add intent-based alerts for partial payloads and a dashboard. ETA: Friday.

maria.g: please add tasks to the postmortem doc and tag owners. Link: https://go/internal/pm-streaming-postmortem. Also tag when PRs are ready so we can schedule canary.

alex.k: client reconnect config I'm planning: 

```
const RECONNECT = {
  baseDelayMs: 200,
  maxDelayMs: 5000,
  jitter: true,
  maxAttempts: 8
};
```

alex.k: server heartbeat idea: send regular small chunk "HB\n" every 15s if no tokens emitted.

lee: partial-response handler concept: detect premature stream end, mark trace/span, increment regression alert. Pseudocode: 

```
if (stream.closed && !stream.eos && tokensEmitted < expectedMin) {
  emitMetric('stream.partial', 1);
  retryPolicy.maybeRetry(stream);
}
```

sre-bot: deploybot: scheduled canary for reconnect-pr on 1772040000, notify #eng-runtime.

sam: added dashboard and alert; created runbook draft, linking to the incident review. TODO: add retrospective action checklist for recurring patterns -> weekly triage for streaming flakiness.

maria.g: perfect. Owners + ETAs noted. Let's reconvene next Tue 10am to verify canary. :thumbsup:
